SISTERS’ NIGHT ✨

Unwind • Connect • Reflect

Join us for a fun evening of games, laughter, sisterhood, and meaningful reflection!

Whether you’re coming with friends or looking to meet new sisters, come enjoy a night filled with:

🎀 Icebreakers & Team Challenges
🎲 Fun Games & Activities
🕌 Reflection
🤍 Sisterhood & Connection
🍵 Refreshments

Take a break from the usual routine, connect with your sisters, have some fun, and leave with a beautiful reminder, in shaa Allah.

📆 Date: Saturday, Sep 19tg, 2026 6:00 - 8:00 PM
💵 Fees: $35
location: 2179 Lawrence Ave E, Scarborough, ON M1P 0E9, Canada
title: Gathering & Games, Sisters Night
